seriesTitle: The Railway Men: The Untold Story of Bhopal 1984

episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: In the hours leading to the disaster, the Union Carbide higher-ups downplay safety concerns at the factory while unwitting souls hang in the balance.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: As the gas descends on the city, passengers at Bhopal Junction break into a frenzy for their lives — and a brave station master springs into action.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: The gas holds the Bhopal passengers hostage while railway workers scramble to figure out a plan. Meanwhile, a visitor to India may have an antidote.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: As new threats rocket towards Bhopal Junction, the railway men face unthinkable dilemmas. Can they act quickly enough to save others — and themselves?
